checks_collection: GitHub REST check-runs filter=all and final-head metadata, read non-atomically after cutoff

provenance.cohort: Workflow CI pull_request runs, paginated fixed windows. Search updated devel PRs and join their latest observed head SHA and same-repo head branch to the runs. Pick midpoint ranks in chronological order per period/path stratum, up to 25 Agentplane backend or test heads and 12 other heads. Read all check-run pages for each exact head, latest check record per required context by check ID. GitHub timestamps have one-second resolution. Latest observed head can differ from the head at cutoff. Workflow run status is a separate denominator with re-runs, fork markers and superseded runs. Path class uses current PR files only when they correspond to the exact SHA.
provenance.clocks: Earliest CI workflow creation in the frame for each exact SHA through the latest accepted required check completion. Job created-to-start includes orchestration and runner dispatch. Receipt, historical push and eligibility require independent clocks.
provenance.runner_census: Used collect.py fixed-window runs and its all-attempt pagination helper. The older active-run sweep raced (26 reported, 14 returned). The clipped sample omits earlier runs and unfinished jobs. Pre-commit, artifact and Test & Build roles use GitHub-hosted Linux runners; outer Remote Bazel uses BuildBuddy. Stable owner-wide capacity is unknown.
provenance.native: CI deterministic test invocation IDs per workflow run and attempt. GetExecution NEW-origin physical TestRunner rows, deduplicated by execution ID, and distinct process and CPU units. Critical paths and exact trace outputs sampled for named cases only. Native action last completion is a screening statistic; recorded Bazel critical path is shown where retrieved. Selected VM and Firecracker trace warm/cold status is independent of cache reuse of the whole action.
provenance.routing: Representative action and command digests decoded for PR #18244. Synthetic test commits fetched from Git database; first parent checked for KVM cutover and Firecracker reuse ancestry; second parent equals measured head. The rollout PR itself includes its own routing change on its head.
provenance.metrics: Mimir builtin dashboard series selectors, filter to up scrapes; 60-second steps. The task gauge includes preparation and upload. Missing task values are omitted. Local reservations can repeat a physical request. CPU measurements use 2-minute rate. Work filesystem follow-up uses /buildbuddy.
provenance.censoring: Fork and non-devel eligibility, exact push time, first API observation, installation/inbox/webhook delivery and agent reads are outside this retained-head analysis. Final latest checks are observed after the sampling window and capture recovery. Earlier PR heads stay in the workflow run counts but do not have exact gate timelines in this snapshot.

gate_headroom.clock: Gate offsets are elapsed seconds from each head's labeled workflow-start proxy, as supplied in the reviewed input.
gate_headroom.assumption: Scenarios subtract the stated seconds from observed gate offsets, clipping each at zero, while holding other gate clocks and dependency structure fixed; adjusted completion order may change. This is a conditional upper-bound sensitivity, not a treatment effect or actual auto-merge readiness; do not add worker or CPU times.

prior_baseline.open: Two-worker floor causal benefit; fleet fixture reuse; 30% or four-minute end-to-end design.

rerun_causes.18106: Gateway crash case saw environment STATE_NOT_READY on typed process read; teardown also reported an unsettled model exchange. Firecracker and VM both passed after long input fetch.
rerun_causes.18243: Provider I/O test returned the typed timeout but never observed its blocked-body Read method start. Its timeout starts 25ms before the real transport has proven a body read.
rerun_causes.18254: Managed Pod-platform action failed provider Firecracker snapshot restore with TSC scaling EINVAL, before reaching the test body.
rerun_causes.18256: Restart case reconnected and received a snapshot whose last cursor equaled the prior cursor. Strict growth assertion failed.
rerun_causes.18273: One PID1 container-test shard reached its timeout; target was green on retry. Early indexed first-failure query returned an empty label for this timeout.

rerun_request_clock: All five GitHub attempt metadata records identify User-type triggering accounts. Provenance cannot distinguish direct user action from a client acting as that identity. Prior red-to-next-job-creation elapsed 32, 93, 253, 661 and 663 seconds. Next-job assignment was 2–8 seconds.

input_fetch_case.qualification: Matching file counts/bytes and overlapping native phase timestamps suggest shared input or transfer pressure. Stats do not identify the CAS object, edge cache, or transfer bottleneck. The cluster OCI mirror is configured for image pulls, a different path from Bazel CAS action input staging.

queue_clock_validation: Bytes and I/O durations come from GetExecution. The 20 inverted VM/Firecracker queue clocks are unknown. CPU coverage is missing for all KVM TestRunner samples used for cost.

cold_execution.limits: The cold execution confirms repeated CAS read stalls. No shared physical cause with #18106 was established.

vm_rebuild_recurrence.mechanism: Recycled Docker action resumes in the private /init cgroup created by prior setup. A fingerprint mismatch forces rebuild and the current guard demands namespace-root membership. Both observed actions passed after an ordinary cold retry.

weekly_feedback.method: 50 PR heads per UTC workflow creation day. From the sampled CI workflow creation to the first observed success of all three required check names in their original workflow runs. Includes successful subsequent job attempts on the head by 20 Nov 21:12:39 UTC. Median uses the midpoint; p90 is nearest rank. Timing is conditional on reaching green.

history_extension.selection: First 24 statuses from the exact target history ordered by invocation creation. Looked up native executions for each and included only origin records. A missing physical origin might be a cache hit or incomplete visibility.

provider_visibility.GetUser: HTTP 500 NotFound under the supplied API key
provider_visibility.capacity_and_account_entitlement: Unknown. Public pricing is not organization-specific. No managed reservation, compatible executor inventory, utilization, lease lifecycle, or admission reason independently verified.

managed_pod_admission.counterfactual: Fixed observed enqueue, preparation, process, upload, other actions, other gates and post-test work. Removing this queue can advance the observed path at most to the latest unchanged physical completion or next required gate. Applies only where the Pod critical path was verified. This is a queue-only ceiling, not measured savings or a population estimate.

worker_signals.counter_method: Maximum fleet-wide two-minute increase sampled at one minute. Prometheus extrapolates counts. Canceled RPCs can result from client cancellation. Use logs and native execution records for exact per-action evidence.

provenance.file_mapping: Decode downloadedFileIndicesBitmap on completed TestRunners against CAS Action input Directory tree in executor traversal order. One blob may serve multiple paths. Counts and bytes reconcile against native IO receipts.
provenance.retry_logs: Exact execution ID in retained worker console logs. Deduplicate same normalized message and timestamp. Retry messages lack blob IDs.

cas_followup.replay_method: Loopback proxy with empty Pebble store, live BuildBuddy Cloud upstream and bb download using the same four exact PR digests. SHA-256 and length verified for all successful reads. Metrics sampled before initial fill and after warm repetition. CLI call wall includes verification.
cas_followup.replay_scope: Single developer host. Two independent read sets in the warm phase. Desktop-route upstream was healthy. Production KVM canary and account pricing or support entitlement are unmeasured.

rows.label: Serial, one case at a time

initial_discard.discard_attempt_cause: BuildBuddy scheduler could not find the requested executor. Kubernetes had replaced the original worker and its current VM, VMI and blank work disk are newer than the serial run.

firecracker_overlap.finding: The matched warm pair ran both cases and they passed. The case lifetimes overlapped for 53.7s. The concurrent TestRunner process was 69.8s faster than the serial process. The interval covering both cases was 66.3s shorter.
firecracker_overlap.method: The last two timed rows reused one warm worker, Docker runner and K3s data mount. The concurrent action was sent to that executor with a scheduler override. All four action input roots agree. The only TestRunner command change was the case limit. Both original case implementations and their own cleanup ran on one stack. The spike omitted supplemental native diagnostics on scenario failures.
firecracker_overlap.limit: The initial concurrent attempt landed on a different worker and started cold. Its process time cannot estimate the concurrency effect. The cgroup memory peak spans the runner lifetime and only detects a new high water mark. GitHub feedback is unmeasured.
firecracker_overlap.decision: The warm pair supports a coverage-preserving implementation experiment. Run a matched cold comparison and repeat across workers before estimating the effect on required CI.
firecracker_overlap.action: Validate the overlap implementation on cold fixtures and more KVM workers.

current_pr_census.method: Same-repository current PR heads targeting devel, joined from CI workflow runs created in this window to exact-head GitHub check-run IDs. Excludes superseded heads, forks and runs without an unambiguous PR match. From first observed workflow creation in this window through the last of the three current required statuses; times conditional on green. In-progress and very recent heads are right-censored.
